YOUR QUESTIONS, ANSWERED

A few things you may be wondering.

Have a more specific requirement?

Let’s talk↗
What needs to be agreed before payroll support begins?+

Discuss workforce coverage, payroll inputs, review dates, approvals, reporting and the responsibilities of each party. The agreed scope governs delivery.

Where can an employee raise a salary concern?+

Use the grievance and support contact route, mentioning the project and the nature of the concern. Do not submit bank credentials or sensitive identity documents through the general enquiry form.
